scenario: A settlement payment via Splitwise (scenario-analysis.md #15, revised 2026-08 per ADR-0007 — settlement is its own entity, never an Expense)
context: Dev owes Friend A net (from expense_electronics_partly_friend and other shared expenses). Dev settles part of it.

settlement.reason: Partial settlement toward outstanding shared-expense balance

note: There is deliberately no Expense and no Allocation anywhere in this fixture (invariants.md #9a) — a Settlement discharges Balance(Dev, Friend A) directly. This 1000 reduces the balance and is counted in ReconciliationRun.ledger_settlements_total; it never appears in ledger_explained_total as new spend (invariants.md #9). No receipt or other Evidence is attached, which is valid and unremarkable (see scenario-analysis.md #28's note on settlements with no receipt) — Evidence has always been optional on a Payment. Contrast with the pre-2026-08 version of this fixture, which forced a trivial Expense + Allocation through the settlement path; that design is superseded, see docs/decisions/0007-settlements-as-events-not-expenses.md.
